restart_policy: If required physical, constitutive, load, execution, or schema identity is not demonstrated: RESTART=REFUSED; REASON=EXPLICIT; FAIL_CLOSED=YES.

execution_identity: WP09 tangent strategy version where applicable

actions.read_legacy_v1: decode and validate for inspection only
actions.migrate_v1_checkpoint: explicit refusal; never synthesize v2 identity

existing_without_component_identity.resume: allowed only when full historical model_signature_v2 and topology match

new.identity_status: VERIFIED when saved with bound model
new.integrity: existing deterministic state component and composite digests
new.metadata_integrity: checkpoint_metadata_digest binds the full canonical schema-v2 metadata including component identities; tampering is rejected
new.file_write: existing temporary-file plus atomic replace path
new.formulation_binding: formulation ID, constitutive state version, tangent strategy version for corrected J2

determinism.canonicalization: existing canonical JSON checkpoint signature and deterministic state digest
determinism.mutable_model: identity recomputed at save/load boundary from serialized model snapshot
determinism.cryptographic_authenticity: NOT_PROVIDED; SHA-based integrity is not an authenticated signature
